module: UI color palette for the rally: one theme color for the loop and one for the stage, with an NGRC mode variant. The functions write the color into the theme field of a target table (data sent to the UI). A global theme color can override all the others.
notes: The override is normalized: spaces removed, # added if absent, #RRGGBB format required; otherwise it is nil (thus disabled).

setThemeOverride.desc: Sets (or clears with nil / invalid value) a theme color that replaces the default colors.

hexOrNil.desc: Hexadecimal color, with or without '#', 6 digits.

updateForLoop.desc: Writes target.theme with the loop color (or the override if it exists). Does nothing if target is nil.
